scope: Initial atomic decomposition of header-line syntax, data-line structure, fixed record fields, INFO grammar and FORMAT/genotype structure for VCFv4.1–4.5. This is not the complete set of requirements in those sections and does not include VCFv4.0 pending source pinning.
method: Read full field paragraphs and adjacent data-line/header/genotype context.
Split independently testable obligations and field semantics into separate candidate records.
Preserve version-specific source applicability; do not infer VCFv4.0 or unreviewed-version applicability.
Use descriptive or NOT_STATED force where the text defines a field rather than expressing a modal obligation.
Keep version-dependent wording and exceptions visible; independent review is required before ledger promotion.

Some proposed acceptance conditions need refinement against the exact per-version normative force and special cases; no implementation verdict is implied.

Normative force is version-sensitive for several clauses; force_by_version is retained in this research candidate register and must be split into version-scoped ledger records where the ledger schema cannot represent a force delta.
